package.name: marine_tiled_raster_store
package.description: Generic GGGS-tiled raster store core: a band/dtype-parametrized tile (TiledRasterTile<T>) and per-tile GeoTIFF persistence, factored out of marine_bathymetry_store so multiple raster sources (bathymetry, sidescan backscatter) share one tiling + persistence contract. See unh_marine_autonomy#172 / #171 / ADR-0002.
